description: Returns one utility's details: what it answers, category, tags, the countries it is specific to (none = everywhere), page URL, the WebMCP tools its page offers, its server API actions, `privacy` (`local`: what the visitor enters never leaves their browser; `server`: it is sent to the site's server to run a check, not stored), and `related`: slugs of the most relevant other utilities, closest first (alternatives if this one is not quite right, then what people often need next).
name: catalog_get_utility
title: Get a utility
